items.note: The eight-row cancel/inject/restore schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of the scratch values, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, and the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) all follow the proof at 741-765. The statement never fixes h=100, the neighbour rules (|S∩T|=1, or even intersection) or the gate maps, and the wire counts W=2N+I(vz+c) of 767-782 are absent.

Frames D_v, edges applying D_v D_u^{-1}, the invariant stored = D_v·logical, commuting with pointwise gates, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} on every role all match 804-825.

Several things are stated correctly: nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional tensor space of triple indicators, neighbours orthogonal via <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, the only loss at central 3->4 (dimension h), telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The derivation is partial because the actual label assignment (the stage transitions and table eq:motif-labels) and the residual table are not given, so comparability on every edge is asserted rather than shown. The orthonormal-basis property of binary residuals (1073-1103) is missing.

The rank sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, with rank equal to dimension change except at the N source edges (2P_{U_a}, rank one), follows 1158-1167, and S1.1.6.3 gives the shear H<-H+D on every role. The assignment of P_U to gates and sinks is never stated, and neither is the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m or its check P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (1169-1171). The plan only cites 'the endpoint condition'.

The phase frames C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{wt(P_U x)})H^{⊗m} and one kernel (aI+bX_v)^{±1} per orthonormal residual vector are stated, with weight additivity mod 4 named as the reason. The total s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m is not stated. The telescoping to C^{⊗m} on every role after the Z_a and i^{27} corrections and undoing the signed exchange (1273-1314) is absent. No sub-steps follow the proof.

The bit side is complete: L<N/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, eta_b=339/22587335000000>20·2^{-50}, and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta) giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. The complex side gives only L_c/N=101/539. It does not state s_c<W_c m, eta_c=73/19906842167500 or the derivation of s_c/W_c<m^sigma, which S2.3 just assumes.

Linear-time digit operations, cyclic row splits and controlled shifts are invoked as tools ('relies on' tape-stream-operations, controlled-shift). Their content, such as the O(V) cost conditions and the b^{O(1)} offset requirement, is never stated as a result.

The steps match the paper's derivation. A=E_1 Pi E_2 is obtained by topmost-row and rightmost-pivot elimination, triangular maps cost O(V) in descending order, the conjugation sequence is given, and each one of Pi takes D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j. The result is exactly a interchanges plus O(V). The plan never says that q is a fixed odd prime chosen to avoid the denominators of the factor table (1413-1423), which the specialization to Z/q^b needs.

Every element of 1491-1588 is present: F_0 by a single-digit operation, the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_M frames giving Phi_{I_m} on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum in both cases a<=1 and a>1, and the O(V) fixed-tape parking.

Several steps match the paper: the high digits rho=O(log e) form a row field of at least W^k rows at cost O(V rho), the base-m pieces give O(V)sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau), and padding [2^u] to [q^e] gives O(Vu^tau). The padding of rows with zero rows to R'=W^k ceil(R/W^k) (1684-1690) is missing. That padding supplies the divisibility the power-width proposition requires, and S1 wrongly attributes it to the high digits.

Present: the basic identities, one kernel per residual vector, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, M as a fixed product of slot row additions, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} is only described. The endpoint corrections (Z_{a,f}, i^{27f}, negating and undoing the exchange) that make the network yield C^{⊗e} on every role (1907-1913) are omitted.

The steps follow 2013-2207: the eight-addition parity cycles, the guard-interval bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, swap/rotate/unswap, extraction plus stable radix sort, and the final time bound. Only the separate final XOR at j_{f-1} is not mentioned.

errors.says: The motivation says the row field divisible by W^k needed by the power-width recursion is supplied by the chunk's own high digits (and a base-m decomposition).
errors.paper: The high digits give only a row range R=q^{2 rho}>=W^k. Divisibility comes from appending zero rows within each prefix until the count is R'=W^k ceil(R/W^k)<2R.

errors.says: The label construction makes the cost of every edge change equal to the dimension of its orthogonal residual.
errors.paper: For the bit network, the N source edges at X_a are exceptions. Their edge matrix 2P_{U_a} has rank one although the dimension change is zero (S1.1.4.4 itself corrects this).

errors.says: The compact sorting of exceptional records is o(V) because the number of visits is polynomial in p while r exceeds every fixed power of p.
errors.paper: The exceptional stream has length O(V_call d 2^{-K}), and the sorting sums to O(V p^{A'} 2^{-K})=o(V) because K=Theta(p^{epsilon c}). The domination by r is what absorbs per-record and per-visit descriptor work.

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. The interchange (S1) and the simultaneous layer (S2) feed the transform layout (S3) and the ring convolution (S4). Resampling, chirp, CRT and twist (S5, S6) assemble the multiplier with exact recovery, and S7 sums the normalized costs with minimum margin 2kappa. It thins at the base of the saving. The network's sizes (h=100, N, m=h^3, W) are never fixed, the bit endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m is only alluded to, and the complex interface (s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, C^{⊗m} on every role after corrections) is not reconstructed, so s_c/W_c<m^sigma is assumed in S2.3. Smaller gaps are the row padding in the arbitrary-width interchange and the ring and chirp error steps behind E_s.

steps.note: The signed exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) that restores every auxiliary wire, built on three-element subsets of [h], is reconstructed. The plan never gives h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3, or the indexing of X_a,Y_a by a in T^3, so the fixed network's sizes are missing. The conservative verdict is mentioned.

One frame per vertex, commuting with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, the route operator D_sink D_source^{-1}, and intermediate frames left free so each edge is cheap. All match the paper.
Nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional tensor space of triple indicators, comparable on every edge, with the only decreasing edge the central 3->4, which removes P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h.

Rank equals dimension change on every edge, with the N source edges as exceptions: 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change. The projection formula P_V-P_U is only implicit (through -P_{U_a}), but the key quantity and the exceptions are present.
The signed sum is Wm-2N, there are Ic decreasing edges of loss h so L=Ich, the absolute sum is Wm-2N+2L, and adding N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, with deficit N-2L_b>0 so s_b<W_b m.

S1.1.6.3 says the frame identity and 'the endpoint condition' give Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D on every row. The identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m is never stated, and neither is why it holds (P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, zero source and identity sink elsewhere).
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular factors, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge, and s recursive calls per node in all.

Children on streams of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and eta_b>20·2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} and F_k=O(e^tau). The fact log m<20 is used implicitly in the displayed inequality.

central.summary: Seven of the nine steps are reconstructed: frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict saving from L/N=100/539<1/2, edges as exactly a recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Two links are thin. C1 gives the exchange but not the network's sizes (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3). C7 cites 'the endpoint condition' giving Phi_{I_m} without stating M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m or the source projection that makes it hold.
